title: Cancelling the screen picker on 'Resume Sharing' emits host-stopped and destroys the reclaimed room
test: tests/browser/host-reload-recovery.spec.mjs: 'cancelling the capture picker on Resume Sharing keeps the reclaimed room, and the next Resume Sharing streams in it' (failed before); 'a resumed room whose media setup fails after the capture is still torn down' (guard, passed before and after). Unit tests: tests/hostRecovery.test.js 'shouldTeardownAfterStartFailure: a reclaimed room survives a failure before its capture is in use' and '... a reclaimed room in use, and every fresh room, are torn down'
proof: Holds. The spec shares for real on its own server.js (claimed ports) with 'Allow recovery after reload' on, reloads, waits for the reclaim and 'Resume Sharing', then makes getDisplayMedia reject with DOMException NotAllowedError (a cancelled picker) and presses Resume Sharing; a page.routeWebSocket proxy forwards the Socket.IO traffic and records every event the page emits. On the unchanged client (vite build into a scratch dir): the page sent host-stopped (Expected not "host-stopped", Received ["host-stopped"]), the server held 0 rooms instead of 1, the recovery record was gone (null), and the button still read Resume Sharing because cleanup() cleared resumeRoomRef but not resumePending, so the second press created a different room (Expected "57PMCD", Received "ZJ2J94"). Output in dev-notes/results/TASK-070-before.txt. After the fix: no host-stopped, the server still holds the room, the record {code, ingestMode: 'browser'} is still stored, the preview's srcObject is null, the alert carries 'Screen sharing was cancelled. Press Resume Sharing to try again.', Resume Sharing is enabled, and the second press streams in the same room with no create-room sent. Fix: handleStartSharing tracks a phase (START_PHASES preflight, capture, room, media, obs in src/lib/hostRecovery.mjs). shouldTeardownAfterStartFailure({ resumed, phase }) is false only for a reclaimed room failing in preflight or capture; there the catch calls a local releaseCaptureOnly() (stops the tracks of this start's stream and of streamRef, clears the video srcObject and streamRef, touches no room ref), ends the start operation on the guard (invalidate 'start-failed', the attempt is over), sets status 'idle' and leaves resumeRoomRef, resumePending and the stored record alone. Every other case keeps the existing stopObsIngest, host-stopped and cleanup(): fresh rooms in every phase, and reclaimed rooms from the room step on (the guard test answers create-send-transport with a failure after a successful capture: host-stopped is sent, the server holds 0 rooms, the record is cleared, the button reads Start Sharing; it passed before and after). Stale starts still leave through abandonIfStale first, unchanged. Checked with npm run lint, npm run typecheck and npm test (1206/1206); the 7 host-reload-recovery tests, the 3 host-obs-control-channel tests and the 12 media-flow scenarios pass on the fixed build.

title: Recovery permits changing ingest mode without replacing the room
test: tests/browser/host-reload-recovery.spec.mjs: 'while a reclaimed browser room waits for Resume Sharing, its ingest mode cannot be switched to OBS' (failed before). Unit tests: tests/hostRecovery.test.js 'recoveredRoomIngestMode reads the mode a reclaimed room was created with' and 'isIngestModeMismatch: only a mode other than the waiting room's own is a mismatch'
proof: Holds. After a real share with reload recovery, a reload and the reclaim, the spec checks the settings while Resume Sharing waits, then takes the toggle's disabled attribute away and clicks it (so whatever reaches handleIngestModeChange is tested too), then presses Resume Sharing. On the unchanged client the OBS toggle and the AV1 toggle were enabled, no hint was shown, the click switched the page to OBS mode (Expected not checked, Received checked), and Resume Sharing reused the recovered browser room without create-room and took the OBS path: no capture, and the browser-capture status 'Streaming (...)' never appeared. After the fix both toggles are disabled while resumePending is true, with the hint 'Locked while the recovered room waits for Resume Sharing: it keeps the ingest mode it was created with.', the forced click leaves the mode on browser (handleIngestModeChange returns when isIngestModeMismatch({ recoveredRoom: resumeRoomRef.current, ingestMode: mode })), and Resume Sharing streams a live capture in the same room with no create-room. handleStartSharing also refuses, before it begins a start operation and without touching the room, when the waiting room's mode differs from ingestMode: it puts the setting back to the room's mode and says so ('This recovered room streams from browser capture and keeps that mode, so the setting was switched back. Press Resume Sharing to continue.'); no browser test reaches that branch, since the toggle lock and the handler guard leave no way to the mismatch, so it is covered by the unit tests of isIngestModeMismatch and recoveredRoomIngestMode (the same helper now sets the mode in adoptReclaimedRoom). Q-003 was taken at its default (lock; no 'discard and create a new room' action). The server is never told another mode. Checked with npm run lint, npm run typecheck and npm test (1206/1206).
